name: Bistro Cloud
description: Example pack for a delivery-only cloud kitchen in Egypt: complaint and review triage, order notes, a social-post gate with its house rules (no prices, no dine-in), and inbox routing for delivery platforms.

presets.name: Complaint triage
presets.description: Route a delivery complaint to the team behind its main problem, gauge frustration, and flag refund, callback and packaging issues.
presets.sample_text: الأوردر وصل متأخر ساعة كاملة والأكل كان بارد خالص، والعلبة كانت مفتوحة والصوص مدلوق على الكيس كله. بجد مش مقبول. عايز فلوسي ترجع، ولو سمحتوا حد يكلمني النهارده.

team.instructions: Which team caused the main problem the customer complains about in `message`?

criteria.kitchen: food taste, freshness, wrong or missing dish (الأكل، الطعم، صنف ناقص أو غلط)
criteria.delivery: late order, food arrived cold, rider, address (تأخير، الأكل وصل بارد، الطيار)
criteria.packaging: box or container open, leaking, spilled sauce, crushed bag (العلبة مفتوحة، الصوص مدلوق، الكيس)
criteria.app_or_payment: app, promo code, payment or double charge (التطبيق، الدفع)
criteria.other: none of the other teams fits

frustration.instructions: How frustrated or angry does the customer sound in `message`?
criteria: concerned: disappointed but polite (زعلان بس بأدب)
annoyed: clearly unhappy, complains firmly (متضايق، مش مقبول)
furious: very angry, insults or shouting (غضبان جدا، شتيمة)

refund_requested.instructions: Does the customer in `message` ask for their money back or a refund?

criteria.true: asks for money back or a refund (عايز فلوسي ترجع، استرجاع)

wants_callback.instructions: Does the customer ask for a phone call back? (هل العميل طالب حد يكلمه أو يتصل بيه؟)

criteria.true: yes, wants someone to call or contact them (عايز حد يكلمه)
criteria.false: no, does not ask for a call (مش طالب مكالمة)

packaging_issue.instructions: Does `message` mention a packaging problem such as an open box, leak or spill?

criteria.true: open, leaking, spilled or crushed packaging (العلبة مفتوحة، مدلوق)

ar.name: فرز الشكاوى
ar.description: وجّه شكوى التوصيل إلى الفريق المسؤول عن مشكلتها الرئيسية، وقدّر درجة الإحباط، ونبّه إلى طلبات الاسترداد ومعاودة الاتصال ومشكلات التغليف.

presets.name: Review sentiment
presets.description: Read a delivery order review for overall sentiment and what it talks about.
presets.sample_text: Ordered the chicken shawarma bowl and the lentil soup for dinner. The food was fresh and full of flavour, honestly the best bowl I've had in El Gouna. Delivery took a bit longer than the app said, but the rider was friendly and everything arrived hot. Will definitely order again.

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of the customer's `review`?

criteria.mixed: both clear praise and clear complaints

mentions_food_quality.instructions: Does the `review` comment on the taste, freshness or quality of the food?

mentions_delivery_speed.instructions: Does the `review` comment on how fast or slow the delivery was?

would_order_again.instructions: Does the `review` say or clearly imply the customer will order again?

ar.name: انطباع المراجعات
ar.description: اقرأ مراجعة طلب توصيل لمعرفة الانطباع العام وما تتحدث عنه.

presets.name: Order note tags
presets.description: Tag the customer's note on a delivery order and flag allergy-safety risks for the kitchen.
presets.sample_text: My son has a severe sesame allergy, so please no tahini or sesame seeds anywhere in his wrap. Thank you!

tag.instructions: What is the main purpose of the customer's order `note`?

criteria.allergy_or_dietary: allergies, intolerances, vegetarian, vegan or other dietary needs
criteria.delivery_instructions: directions, gate, building, floor or when to call on arrival
criteria.cooking_preference: spice level, doneness, sauce on the side, remove an ingredient by taste
criteria.cutlery_or_extras: cutlery, napkins, extra sauces or condiments

is_allergy_safety_critical.instructions: Does the `note` describe an allergy where a mistake could harm someone's health?

criteria.true: a real allergy or medical restriction the kitchen must follow
criteria.false: a preference, or no health risk mentioned

ar.name: وسوم ملاحظات الطلبات
ar.description: صنّف ملاحظة العميل على طلب التوصيل، ونبّه المطبخ إلى مخاطر الحساسية الغذائية.

presets.name: Delivery review triage
presets.description: Triage a delivery order review: sentiment, main topic (food, delivery, packaging, app, price, staff), and whether it needs a reply, compensation or moderation.
presets.sample_text: الأكل طعمه حلو بس الشوربة وصلت مدلوقة في الكيس والعلبة مكسورة. أول مرة يحصل كده، ياريت تهتموا بالتغليف أكتر.

sentiment.instructions: What is the overall sentiment of `review`?

criteria.mixed: clear praise and clear complaints together

wants_compensation.instructions: Does `review` ask for a refund, compensation or a free replacement?

toxic.instructions: Does `review` contain insults, swearing, threats or hate?

ar.name: فرز مراجعات التوصيل
ar.description: فرز مراجعة توصيل لـ Bistro Cloud: الانطباع والموضوع الرئيسي، وهل تحتاج إلى رد أو تعويض أو إشراف.

presets.name: DM / comment intent (restaurant)
presets.description: Route an Instagram, Facebook or WhatsApp message to the kitchen: order status, complaint, menu question, catering, collaboration, job, spam; order problem and Franco-Arabic.
presets.sample_text: salam, ana 3amel order men sa3a w lessa ma weselsh, el order rakamo 5521. momken te2olly howa fein?

intent.instructions: What does the sender of `message` want from Bistro Cloud?

criteria.complaint: problem with food or an order
criteria.menu_question: question about dishes, allergens or hours

order_problem.instructions: Does `message` report a problem with an order?

is_franco_arabic.instructions: Is `message` Arabic written in Latin letters, using digits like 3 and 7 for sounds?

ar.name: نية الرسائل والتعليقات (مطعم)
ar.description: وجّه رسالة إنستجرام أو فيسبوك أو واتساب إلى Bistro Cloud: النية، ومشكلات الطلبات، والكتابة بالفرانكو.

presets.name: Social post gate (delivery only, no prices)
presets.description: Check an outbound post or reply before publishing against the house rules: no prices or discounts, no dine-in, tables or rooftop (delivery only), no promises, no health claims, no personal data; tone.
presets.sample_text: Our new rooftop terrace is open! Book a table tonight and enjoy 30% off every bowl. Guaranteed at your door in 20 minutes or it's free.

mentions_amount.instructions: Does `draft` mention a price, discount or percentage?

mentions_dine_in.instructions: Does `draft` mention dine-in, tables, seating, booking, a rooftop or a terrace?

health_claim.instructions: Does `draft` make a medical or health claim about the food?

personal_data.instructions: Does `draft` contain a phone number or home address?

tone.instructions: How well does `draft` fit a warm, friendly, confident food brand voice?
criteria: off-brand: rude, aggressive, sarcastic or sloppy
weak: flat, pushy or overly salesy

ar.name: بوابة المنشورات (توصيل فقط، بدون أسعار)
ar.description: افحص منشورًا أو ردًا صادرًا قبل نشره وفق قواعد المطبخ: لا أسعار ولا خصومات، ولا أكل في المكان (توصيل فقط)، ولا وعود، ولا ادعاءات صحية، ولا بيانات شخصية؛ والنبرة.

presets.name: Inbox triage (delivery platforms)
presets.description: Route the kitchen's inbox: suppliers, delivery platforms (Talabat, Breadfast, Instashop), customers, catering, jobs, tax, bank, spam and phishing; urgency and reply.
presets.sample_text: Dear partner, your weekly payout statement for 15-21 September is ready. 3 orders were flagged as late and the adjustments are shown in the attached report. Please review them in the partner portal within 7 days. Talabat Partner Support

criteria.customer_complaint: a customer unhappy with an order
criteria.job_application: CV or asking for a job
criteria.phishing: fake login, prize or payment scam

urgency.instructions: How urgent is the request in `email`?

needs_reply.instructions: Does `email` ask Bistro Cloud a question or request something?

is_phishing.instructions: Is `email` a phishing or scam attempt to steal money, logins or data?

ar.name: فرز البريد (منصات التوصيل)
ar.description: وجّه بريد Bistro Cloud: الموردون ومنصات التوصيل والعملاء والطلبيات والوظائف والضرائب والبنوك والرسائل المزعجة والتصيّد، مع الإلحاح والحاجة إلى رد.
